name: Flint (United States)
description: Light blue field charged with the name Flint in white script with a red spark at the fly.
history: Flint is the county seat of Genesee County, Michigan. According to the Flint Public Library quoted on Flags of the World, no official flag is specified; former Mayor James Rutherford designed an unofficial flag during his first term from 1975, redesigned in the 1990s by former Mayor Woodrow Stanley, and the light blue flag with the script name has been seen flying at the city offices.
